metadata.note: Issue #353, review round 1: a dictionary concept the KB's bridge files on TWO substances. The three drug rows carry the shipped knowledge base's own identifying fields for DDInter1340 Omeprazole, DDInter676 Esomeprazole and DDInter383 Clopidogrel; their ciel[] arrays are TRIMMED to the one bridge row each case needs, and CIEL 75876 'Esomeprazole magnesium' is filed on the first two exactly as the shipped bridge files it - the population ADR Decision 68 measures at 46 of 4251 bridged concepts. The two are two substances because their shared rxnorm_name family holds two drugbank_ids, which is DdiDrugReferenceSource.substanceIds' own rule. The interaction row carries the shipped rating for Clopidogrel/Omeprazole and NO mechanism text, so the fixture invents no clinical prose; Esomeprazole deliberately carries no rule with Clopidogrel, so the substance the chip is about is the one the bridge did NOT name and a false attribution to the prescription is legible.
